categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Modifies the libbitcoinkernel public C API and C++ wrapper headers and implementations in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.*.
categories.rationale: Prevents misleading API semantics where multiple logging connections implied independent loggers despite an underlying global singleton. The change aligns the API boundary with the underlying KernelLogger implementation without adding new library capabilities.
